scope: Independent functional acceptance of frozen local products only. Original source/request read; no skills, model replies, protocol groups, or other evaluations read. No product modified.

originalLimitations.details: 390x844 touch outer viewport yields actual CSS innerWidth/clientWidth=980 and innerHeight=2121 because original page lacks viewport meta.
Phone writing pane overlays download dialog and intercepts Markdown/HTML/close taps; switching to reading mode enables both downloads.
Phone writing pane covers preview; reading entry exposes it.
Ctrl+Shift+S does not open download menu when content equals browser-saved content.
Original spell-check library requests jsDelivr en_US.aff/dic; all external network blocked in this review.

baseline.calibration: Raw baseline/results.json retained. SweetAlert adds visible after 500ms; early overwrite confirmation was an automation-readiness issue. baseline-overwrite/results.json uses the actual visible state and passes both targets; baseline-effective.json substitutes these corrected checks.
